name: appsmith
description_en: Platform to build admin panels, internal tools, and dashboards. Integrates with 25+ databases and any API.
readme_excerpt: Organizations build custom applications like dashboards, admin panels, customer 360, IT automation, and service management tools to help their teams work more efficiently and effectively. Appsmith is an open-source low-code platform that streamlines custom application development, deployment, and maintenance. Learn more on our website.
